cases.title: Tamponade - TEE Requested After Suboptimal TTE
cases.vignette: 64-year-old female admitted to ICU with severe cellulitis, develops progressive hypotension refractory to vasopressors. Suboptimal transthoracic imaging by ICU team suggests possible pericardial effusion. TEE requested. See clips below.
cases.quiz: You see the vignette + clips above. What is the key diagnosis and what two echo signs support tamponade physiology?
cases.findings:
1. Large circumferential pericardial effusion
2. Right atrial systolic collapse
3. Right ventricular diastolic collapse
